title: Turn trust into a deployment gate

scenes.heading: Make deployment wait for proof
scenes.sub: Put the check before the handoff.
voice: Your pipeline has a rendered bundle and a deployment stage ready to go.
Make that handoff depend on verification, so your policy can stop an unqualified artifact.

scenes.heading: Require verified trust
voice: AICR checks the bundle inventory and attestation, verifies the binary attestation against NVIDIA CI, and requires the bundle to use embedded data.

scenes.heading: Watch a valid bundle fall short
scenes.sub: Attested can be below your policy.
voice: A signed bundle built with external data can qualify as attested.
When the pipeline requires verified, AICR returns a nonzero exit code and the deployment stage stays blocked.

scenes.heading: Pass through the tested artifact
scenes.sub: Keep the artifact the same at handoff.
voice: When verification meets your policy, pass that same bundle to the deployment stage.
The check now sits before every handoff to the tool that changes the cluster.

payoff: Enforce verified trust in CI and watch a valid but lower-trust bundle stop before deployment.
